description: Land Acquisition - Akarahediya, Laggala D/S Division, Pallegama, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition matters. It contains a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for acquiring specific parcels of land for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reforms, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister of Lands is incidental to the land acquisition declaration rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
